reviews.text: Have been going here for years! Maryam is the owner and she is great, my hair and color are always spot on!

Raja colored my hair and it’s the most beautiful it has ever been. Everyone stops me to tell me how gorgeous the color is! I recommend Raja to anyone looking to get some color done; nobody can do it like her. She also styled and cut my hair and did it exactly how I wanted, just like she always does.
I come here for everything! Maryam and the girls are great! They really go above and beyond, making sure everything looks perfect for you! I highly recommend.
